panel-d1.wrong: Copying and deep copying fail for the same reason as pickling.
panel-d1.correct: The object-valued members in src/click/_utils.py:7–20 use default enum reduction by value. Pickle serializes the object value and reconstructs a fresh object, which does not equal the original enum value; enum reconstruction raises ValueError. Copy and deepcopy already return the original enum member. Reproduction: import copy,pickle; from click import Option; from click._utils import UNSET; o=Option(["--name"]); assert copy.copy(o).default is UNSET; assert copy.deepcopy(o).default is UNSET; pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(o)). The final expression raises ValueError before a fix. Name-based enum reduction addresses reconstruction without changing the working copy behavior.

panel-d2.incomplete: nocase selects the i flag when flags are absent.
panel-d2.wrong: An explicitly empty flags string suppresses the nocase fallback.
panel-d2.correct: lib/picomatch.js:244–263 compiles state and delegates regex construction; line 323 constructs RegExp with opts.flags || (opts.nocase ? "i" : ""). Absent or empty flags fall back to i when nocase is true. Nonempty flags override the fallback. Run node -e 'const p=require("./"); for(const flags of [undefined,"","m"]){const opts={nocase:true,...(flags===undefined?{}:{flags})}; console.log(p("foo.js",opts)("FOO.JS"),p("foo.js",opts)("foo.js"),p("foo.js",opts)("bar.js"));}'. Expected rows: true true false; true true false; false true false. Empty flags are the exception to an interpretation that explicit flags always override nocase.

panel-d3.wrong: impl.transform overwrites enabled=false; wrapper.convert preserves false.
panel-d3.correct: wrapper.ts:2–5 converts options.enabled with || true; explicit false is falsy and becomes true. The re-export index.ts:1 forwards that wrapper. impl.ts:2–5 itself returns the input when enabled === false. Run node --experimental-strip-types -e 'import {format} from "./index.ts"; import {transform} from "./impl.ts"; console.log(format("MiXeD",{enabled:false}),transform("MiXeD",{enabled:false}));'. Expected: MIXED MiXeD. The defect is at the wrapper boundary; nullish defaulting would preserve false.

panel-t1.wrong: An ignored matching path fires onMatch before onIgnore.
panel-t1.correct: lib/picomatch.js:59–89 builds the ignore matcher with ignore and onMatch/onResult disabled for that nested matcher. The outer matcher calls onResult before deciding a miss or checking isIgnored. Run node -e 'const p=require("./");let e=[];const m=p("*.js",{ignore:"skip.js",onResult:()=>e.push("result"),onIgnore:()=>e.push("ignore"),onMatch:()=>e.push("match")});for(const s of ["ok.js","skip.js","no.txt"]){e=[];console.log(m(s),e);}'. Expected: true [result,match]; false [result,ignore]; false [result]. Ignored matches never call the outer onMatch.

panel-i2.wrong: Changing BackendQueryConnection.execute cannot affect warm query adapters.
panel-i2.correct: BackendQueryConnection.execute is the structural SQL/cursor protocol in src/codira/contracts.py. SQLiteIndexBackend.open_connection (packages/codira-backend-sqlite/src/codira_backend_sqlite/__init__.py:337) supplies sqlite3.Connection. DuckDBConnection.execute and _DuckDBCursorCompatibilityAdapter.execute in the DuckDB package preserve compatible result/cursor semantics. Query symbol resolution, task anchors, context expansion and other SQL query callers consume these connections. WarmQuerySession/QueryRuntime in src/codira/query_daemon.py retain connections across calls; mcp/proxy.py _ConnectionExecutor.execute forwards a connection to an operation, so its execute signature is an operation executor, not the SQL protocol method. Include backend package contract tests, tests/test_mcp_contract.py and tests/test_query_daemon_contract.py/test_query_daemon_services.py. Static declarations and typed callers identify first-party impact; structural third-party implementations and dynamic dispatch cannot be proven complete by an identifier search.
